subject: Static inventory of unsalted digests of individual redacted private values and path prefixes in 11 unpublished followup archives, ancillary metadata, and a pinned older committed evidence tree.

staged_scope.qualification: No match to recovered values and checked encodings in followup 42; undiscovered values and encodings remain outside scope. This does not imply a universal privacy clearance.

older_committed_scope.qualification: The zero nested matches apply only to decoded views. Because 4,188 ZIP members remain unread, nine not-observed fields are not proven absent from the full historical tree.

distinct_nonprivate_categories.explanation: These 1,701 fields hash whole queue objects, not individual paths; the 243 reference sequences agree across seven copies, and the three referenced shell queue objects were unchanged between its restricted original and reconstructed version.
distinct_nonprivate_categories.qualification: The binary pattern occurrences were detected in gzip stored bytes and are not established individual private path values.

attribution_and_limits: The reviewer authored the previously published independent 13K review, one of the 15 affected top-level files; this is prior involvement, not an independent re-review of that assessment.
Two cloth files used the same file-local placeholder for two different private values, established by restricted original comparison.
Exact original/private bytes remain separately retained under the two input retention manifests; stage/public or reconstructed bytes must not be represented as originals.
The older comparison is the committed a0d09 tree, not the current working tree or an assertion about later remote state.

Hashes and field comparisons cover recovered values, normalized prefixes and raw/JSON-string representations under SHA-256, SHA-1 and MD5; unknown values, algorithms, encodings and unread members remain outside scope.
No product execution, implementation, build, tests, runtime probes, publication edits or changes to the frozen input packets.
The successor transport review is a separate review; this inventory describes the earlier two staged inputs.
private_value_disclosure: No individual private values or their digest encodings are included. Whole-file and Git identities are retained as evidence identities.
